hebrewText: וְ/אֶת רֵאשִׁ֣ית עֲרִיסֹתֵ֣י/נוּ וּ֠/תְרוּמֹתֵי/נוּ וּ/פְרִ֨י כָל עֵ֜ץ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָ֗ר נָבִ֤יא לַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ אֶל לִשְׁכ֣וֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/מַעְשַׂ֥ר אַדְמָתֵ֖/נוּ לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הֵם֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הַֽ/מְעַשְּׂרִ֔ים בְּ/כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֥י עֲבֹדָתֵֽ/נוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: the first, in place, time, order or rank (specifically, a firstfruit)
tokens.kjv: beginning, chief(-est), first(-fruits, part, time), principal thing.

tokens.bdb: meal
tokens.kjv: dough.

tokens.bdb: a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute
tokens.kjv: gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

tokens.bdb: fruit (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bough, (first-)fruit(-ful), reward.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] carpenter, gallows, helve, [phrase] pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.

tokens.bdb: must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine
tokens.kjv: (new, sweet) wine.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: must or fresh grape-juice ; by implication  fermented wine
tokens.enLiteralWord: must or fresh grape-juice ; by implication  fermented wine
tokens.explanation: must or fresh grape-juice ; by implication  fermented wine
tokens.explanationEn: must or fresh grape-juice ; by implication  fermented wine

tokens.bdb: oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing
tokens.kjv: [phrase] anointed oil.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging)
tokens.kjv: chamber, parlour. Compare H5393 (נִשְׁכָּה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.enLiteralWord: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.explanation: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.explanationEn: a room in a building (whether for storage

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanation: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.

tokens.bdb: a tenth; especially a tithe
tokens.kjv: tenth (part), tithe(-ing).

tokens.bdb: soil (from its general redness)
tokens.kjv: country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.

tokens.explanationEn: a Levite or descendant of Levi

tokens.kjv: it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

tokens.bdb: to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth
tokens.kjv: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.

tokens.bdb: work of any kind
tokens.kjv: act, bondage, [phrase] bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, [idiom] wrought.
